name: 45414 · Dayton, OH
findings: ZIP 45414 (Dayton) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45414 (Dayton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
